description.value: Cortado Cafe and Coffee House is a community-focused cafe in the Walnut Grove neighbourhood of Langley, opened in September 2024 by long-time locals who saw a gap in the area. They partner with Republica Roasters to serve locally roasted coffee alongside in-house food prepared daily from Fraser Valley ingredients. The cafe emphasizes sustainability, vegan and gluten-free options, and outdoor seating, making it a welcoming stop for visitors passing through.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 37m; rack (6 spaces, covered) at 96m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM record: address (21183 88th Ave Unit 105), phone (236-451-2155), and business name all match. The website explicitly confirms vegan and gluten-free menu options and an online ordering/takeout system. No mention of bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere in the website content, so those remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational cafe with a live website, confirmed contact details, and outdoor seating — a useful stop for touring cyclists in Langley.
